title: NBN POI 2CFS (Coffs Harbour), 2MIR (Miranda), 2GRN (Grafton) - Fibre Splicing Works
current_summary: Planned fibre splicing work is scheduled to take place affecting some NBN services in Coffs Harbour, Miranda, and Grafton (POIs 2CFS, 2MIR, 2GRN). The maintenance window will run from Thursday, 13 August at 11:00 PM to Friday, 14 August at 7:00 AM AEST. During this time, services in the affected areas may experience service interruptions for up to 8 hours within the window.

updates.content: We will be performing planned network works that may impact some NBN services in Coffs Harbour, Miranda and Grafton (POIs 2CFS, 2MIR, 2GRN). An upstream network provider will complete fibre splicing during the maintenance window from Thursday 13 August, 11:00 PM to Friday 14 August, 7:00 AM AEST. Services in the affected areas may experience interruptions during this time (up to 8 hours within the window). Our team will monitor progress and work to minimise disruption. If you have issues after the window ends, please contact our support team.
